messages:
Nora: Rolled q-next-int4 into canary this morning. Seeing a reproducible quality delta on our multi-paragraph summary promptset (promptset-L). Requesting triage: could be quant numeric path or a seedbank alignment issue. :thinking:
Eli: Can you paste a trimmed failing example and quick metric diffs? small numbers might be noise.
Nora: Example (redacted):
```
Article: ... long article ...
Gold: 4 bullet outcomes, factual stats
q-baseline (int8): matches bullets, no invented stats
q-next-int4: misses bullet #3 and invents a percent value
```
Nora: Batch diffs vs int8 baseline: ROUGE-L -2.1, F1 -1.6, hallucination +0.09. Failures concentrate on inputs with repeated entity spans and >600 tokens.
Sam: We shipped a seedbank reindex last night that changed anchor ids. That can break microgolden alignment. Recommend: fuzzy dedupe sweep + 180-sample golden relabel focused on the failure cluster.
Rita: Labeling ops can take that if you post sample ids. Set QA pass >=94% and tag "fabricated-fact".
Nora: Running dedupe locally. Command: ```bash
python infra/dedupe.py --in promptset-L.json --threshold 0.80 --out dedup_2881234567.json\``` 
label-bot: Created LabelFlow task LR-830 "q-next-int4 promptset-L microgolden" 180 items, priority: high, ETA 48h. :robot_face:
Eli: Parallel to relabel, please run a small ablation matrix: int8 baseline, int4-legacy-softmax, int4-fused-softmax (current) on identical hardware. If legacy-softmax matches int8 we blame fused-softmax numeric drift.
Sam: Also capture provenance for anchors that changed after the reindex and include them in the relabel set. If relabel clears, it's alignment; if not, it's kernel numeric.
ops-bot: Canary fallback rule proposed: tokens>600 OR turns>3 -> int8-canary. Approve?
Rita: Approve. Will stand up relabel and monitor LR-830. I'll ping when the batch starts and when QA hits threshold.
Nora: Thanks. I'll post ablation table and relabel summary here. If both point to numeric drift, we should open a runtime rollback for fused-softmax on canary only.
Eli: Agreed. Please @channel with results so we can decide rollback vs golden refresh. :white_check_mark:
